canonicalEncoding.inputs: u32 caseCount, then per case: u32 caseId, u16 operationId, u32 payloadLength, payload
canonicalEncoding.record: u32 recordByteCount (bytes after this field), u32 caseId, u16 operationId, u16 outcomeTag, payload
canonicalEncoding.list: u32 elementCount followed by elements in declared order

operations.operation: BinaryHeap script, (priority, value) ordered by priority only
operations.input: u32 opCount; op = u8 0 push (i32 priority, i32 value) | u8 1 pop | u8 2 peek
operations.payload: u32 observationCount, observations (option<i32 priority, i32 value>), u32 finalCount

operations.input: u32 opCount; op = u8 0 insert (i32 key, i32 p) | 1 decreaseKey (i32 key, i32 p) | 2 update (i32 key, i32 p) | 3 remove (i32 key) | 4 pop | 5 peek | 6 contains (i32 key) | 7 count
operations.payload: u32 opCount, then per op u8 status (0 done, 1 refused) and: remove/contains u8 bool; pop/peek option<i32 key, i32 p>; count u32

operations.input: u32 count; vector = u8 function, i32 a, i32 b (raw); functions 0 add, 1 sub, 2 mul, 3 div, 4 sqrt a, 5 neg a, 6 abs a, 7 ofRatio, 8 ofInt a, 9 toIntFloor a, 10 toIntCeiling a, 11 toIntRound a, 12 compare, 13 operator *, 14 operator /
operations.payload: u32 count, then one i32 per vector

operations.input: u16 width, u16 height, width*height u8 cells (0 wall, else entry cost), i32 sx, sy, gx, gy, u8 mode (0 Dijkstra, 1 A* with Manhattan/Chebyshev times the least cell cost, 2 distances), u8 neighbourhood (4 or 8), i32 maxExpanded; tie-break row-major (y, then x)
operations.payload: modes 0-1: u8 outcome (0 found: i32 cost, list<i32 x, i32 y> path | 1 unreachable | 2 budget exhausted), u32 expanded; mode 2: list<i32 x, i32 y, i32 cost> in settle order

operations.input: u8 sub: 0 seed (i32 seed, u32 n) | 1 ofState (4 i32, u32 n) | 2 split (i32 seed, u32 n) | 3 nextBelow (i32 seed, i32 bound, u32 n) | 4 jump (i32 seed, u32 n) | 5 nextInRange (i32 seed, i32 lo, i32 hi, u32 n)
operations.payload: 0: 4 i32 state, n i32 outputs; 1: n outputs; 2: parent state, n outputs, child state, n outputs; 3: n values, 4 i32 final state; 4: jumped state, n outputs; 5: n values

operations.input: i32 seed, u32 pairs; per pair four xoshiro128** draws x, y, z, t give a = x >>> (y & 15) and b = z >>> (t & 15) (arithmetic shifts)
operations.payload: u32 pairs, then 9 i32 digests (h = imul(h xor r, 16777619) from 0x811C9DC5) of add, sub, mul, div, ofRatio, sqrt a, neg a, toIntRound a, compare

inputsGenerator: scripts/lockstep-fixtures.py generate (fixed constants and a 32-bit LCG; no clock, network or host randomness)
independentOracle: scripts/lockstep-fixtures.py oracle: exact Python integers for operations 1, 2, 3, 5 and 10 (the 10^5-pair sweep recomputed exactly); optimal cost, path validity and settle order for operation 4

outcomeTags.1: operation refused its input (an exception); the payload is empty

comparison: The .NET build and the Fable/Node build of tests/FS.GG.Algorithms.Lockstep emit the complete canonical byte stream; both must equal expected.bin, whose SHA-256 is oracleSha256.
